[Open it](/automations/jn7ewwqrf29pb8vzeyrr83d39s8jdvgm)

- **Start:** it runs each time someone on the team uploads a video.
- **Cut into short clips:** it cuts the recording at pauses in speech into clips that fit Instagram Reels' length limit, and reframes them for that format.
- **Add captions:** each clip gets captions that are transcribed automatically. They're bold, in capitals, up to 4 words per line, at the bottom centre, and the spoken word is highlighted as it's said.

I assumed Instagram Reels because you didn't name a platform. I can switch it to TikTok, YouTube Shorts or another one. I can also change the caption style.
